source_text: We only picked up worthless chatter from two of the transmitters, but the third picked up something quite creepy.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.We only picked up worthless chatter from two of the transmitters, but the third picked up something quite creepy.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.We only picked up worthless chatter from two of the transmitters, but the third picked up something quite creepy."

translation: Odebraliśmy tylko bezwartościowe pogaduchy z dwóch nadajników, ale trzeci wychwycił coś dość upiornego.

source_text: Which one was that?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Which one was that?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Which one was that?"

translation: Który to był?

source_text: The one coming from the east side of the mansion.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.The one coming from the east side of the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.The one coming from the east side of the mansion."

translation: Ten ze wschodniej strony rezydencji.

source_text: … The food storage room.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.… The food storage room.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.… The food storage room."

translation: … Spiżarni.

source_text: Let me hear it.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Let me hear it.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Let me hear it."

translation: Daj posłuchać.

source_text: Listen to this.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Listen to this.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Listen to this."

translation: Posłuchaj tego.

source_text: What the hell is that?

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.What the hell is that?
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.What the hell is that?"

translation: Co to, do cholery, jest?

source_text: I heard something similar, but faint when I was in the kitchen.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I heard something similar, but faint when I was in the kitchen.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I heard something similar, but faint when I was in the kitchen."

translation: Słyszałem coś podobnego, ale cicho, gdy byłem w kuchni.

source_text: What’s going on over there? Some sort of cult activity?

structure.raw_value: KiWoOp.What’s going on over there? Some sort of cult activity?
structure.script_literal: "KiWoOp.What’s going on over there? Some sort of cult activity?"

translation: Co się tam dzieje? Jakaś działalność kultu?

source_text: Did you get anything else?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Did you get anything else?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Did you get anything else?"

translation: Masz coś jeszcze?

source_text: That was the end of the recording. The transmitter stopped responding after this.

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.That was the end of the recording. The transmitter stopped responding after this.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.That was the end of the recording. The transmitter stopped responding after this."

translation: To był koniec nagrania. Nadajnik przestał odpowiadać po tym.

source_text: It’s broken?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.It’s broken?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.It’s broken?"

translation: Zepsuty?

source_text: Or out of batteries… But the other two are still online.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Or out of batteries… But the other two are still online.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Or out of batteries… But the other two are still online."

translation: Albo wyczerpały się baterie… Ale pozostałe dwa wciąż działają.

source_text: I don’t know what it could be, but something strange is happening at the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I don’t know what it could be, but something strange is happening at the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I don’t know what it could be, but something strange is happening at the mansion."

translation: Nie wiem, co to może być, ale w rezydencji dzieje się coś dziwnego.

source_text: We can figure this out, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.We can figure this out, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.We can figure this out, 1Hero."

translation: Rozgryziemy to, 1Hero.

source_text: If Andrea finds out I’m helping you do this, my career is over.

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.If Andrea finds out I’m helping you do this, my career is over.
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.If Andrea finds out I’m helping you do this, my career is over."

translation: Jeśli Andrea dowie się, że ci w tym pomagam, moja kariera jest skończona.

source_text: I know this is a big risk to you. But we’ll make it worth your effort.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.I know this is a big risk to you. But we’ll make it worth your effort.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.I know this is a big risk to you. But we’ll make it worth your effort."

translation: Wiem, że to dla ciebie duże ryzyko. Ale wynagrodzimy twój wysiłek.

source_text: I’m not going to take bribes. I’m only in this because I want to know what’s going on at the mansion…

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I’m not going to take bribes. I’m only in this because I want to know what’s going on at the mansion…
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I’m not going to take bribes. I’m only in this because I want to know what’s going on at the mansion…"

translation: Nie zamierzam brać łapówek. Jestem w to zaangażowany tylko dlatego, że chcę wiedzieć, co dzieje się w rezydencji…

source_text: Kimura is not too keen on the idea of me interfering with… her own operations.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Kimura is not too keen on the idea of me interfering with… her own operations.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Kimura is not too keen on the idea of me interfering with… her own operations."

translation: Kimura nie jest zachwycona pomysłem, bym ingerował w… jej własne operacje.

source_text: It’s about a stolen painting.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.It’s about a stolen painting.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.It’s about a stolen painting."

translation: Chodzi o skradziony obraz.

source_text: A stolen painting?

structure.raw_value: KiBaOp.A stolen painting?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaOp.A stolen painting?"

translation: Skradziony obraz?

source_text: A highly valuable Rembrandt. The Guild wants it and they are here to steal it…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.A highly valuable Rembrandt. The Guild wants it and they are here to steal it…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.A highly valuable Rembrandt. The Guild wants it and they are here to steal it…"

translation: Niezwykle cenny Rembrandt. Gildia go pragnie i jest tu, by go ukraść…

source_text: But we’re working on it and that’s why you have to stay away from the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.But we’re working on it and that’s why you have to stay away from the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.But we’re working on it and that’s why you have to stay away from the mansion."

translation: Ale pracujemy nad tym i dlatego musisz trzymać się z daleka od rezydencji.

source_text: Holy shit! You’re luring them in? Then why keep guard there?

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.Holy shit! You’re luring them in? Then why keep guard there?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.Holy shit! You’re luring them in? Then why keep guard there?"

translation: Jasna cholera! Wabiacie ich? Więc po co tam straż?

source_text: We can’t make it easy. It would be too obvious…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.We can’t make it easy. It would be too obvious…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.We can’t make it easy. It would be too obvious…"

translation: Nie możemy im tego ułatwiać. Byłoby to zbyt oczywiste…

source_text: But they will be back.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.But they will be back.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.But they will be back."

translation: Ale wrócą.

source_text: Now isn’t that interesting.

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.Now isn’t that interesting.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.Now isn’t that interesting."

translation: Teraz to interesujące.

source_text: You want a good story? Then let us do our job, and you’ll get the scoop after we arrest them.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.You want a good story? Then let us do our job, and you’ll get the scoop after we arrest them.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.You want a good story? Then let us do our job, and you’ll get the scoop after we arrest them."

translation: Chcesz dobrą historię? Pozwól nam wykonać pracę, a dostaniesz newsa po ich aresztowaniu.

source_text: What about Wilkes? And the daughter?

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.What about Wilkes? And the daughter?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.What about Wilkes? And the daughter?"

translation: A co z Wilkesem? I córką?

source_text: That’s something you and I are going to figure out together…

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.That’s something you and I are going to figure out together…
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.That’s something you and I are going to figure out together…"

translation: To coś, co razem rozgryziemy…

source_text: Just promise me you’re on our side. We’ll give you what you want, you just have to wait.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Just promise me you’re on our side. We’ll give you what you want, you just have to wait.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Just promise me you’re on our side. We’ll give you what you want, you just have to wait."

translation: Po prostu obiecaj mi, że jesteś po naszej stronie. Dam ci to, czego chcesz, tylko musisz poczekać.

source_text: Sounds like we’re going to have an interesting interview tonight…

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.Sounds like we’re going to have an interesting interview tonight…
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.Sounds like we’re going to have an interesting interview tonight…"

translation: Zapowiada się ciekawy wywiad dziś wieczorem…

source_text: Next time you’re in the mansion, replace the broken one with this.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Next time you’re in the mansion, replace the broken one with this.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Next time you’re in the mansion, replace the broken one with this."

translation: Następnym razem, gdy będziesz w rezydencji, wymień zepsuty na ten.

source_text: Andrea has arrived. Are you ready?

structure.raw_value: PlBaOp.Andrea has arrived. Are you ready?
structure.script_literal: "PlBaOp.Andrea has arrived. Are you ready?"

translation: Andrea przybyła. Jesteś gotowy?

source_text: Shit. I still need to change.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Shit. I still need to change.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Shit. I still need to change."

translation: Cholera. Muszę się jeszcze przebrać.

source_text: We’ll get ready. See you in the studio.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.We’ll get ready. See you in the studio.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.We’ll get ready. See you in the studio."

translation: Przygotujemy się. Do zobaczenia w studiu.

source_text: Let’s go. I’ll fix you up.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Let’s go. I’ll fix you up.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Let’s go. I’ll fix you up."

translation: Chodźmy. Doprowadzę cię do porządku.

source_text: Any time, Detective.

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Any time, Detective.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Any time, Detective."

translation: Zawsze, detektywie.

source_text: I’ve been checking the recordings and nothing stood out, but in the last hour we got this.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.I’ve been checking the recordings and nothing stood out, but in the last hour we got this.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.I’ve been checking the recordings and nothing stood out, but in the last hour we got this."

translation: Sprawdzałam nagrania i nic nie zwracało uwagi, ale w ostatniej godzinie dostaliśmy to.

source_text: There’s something in that room that opens a secret passage.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.There’s something in that room that opens a secret passage.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.There’s something in that room that opens a secret passage."

translation: W tym pokoju jest coś, co otwiera tajne przejście.

source_text: 1Hero… I had a dream last night.

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.1Hero… I had a dream last night.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.1Hero… I had a dream last night."

translation: 1Hero… Miałam dziś w nocy sen.

source_text: I dreamt of a secret passage. There was an eye and a gargoyle…

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.I dreamt of a secret passage. There was an eye and a gargoyle…
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.I dreamt of a secret passage. There was an eye and a gargoyle…"

translation: Śniło mi się tajne przejście. Było tam oko i gargulec…

source_text: It’s probably just a coincidence… But this is creeping me out.

structure.raw_value: KiWoOp.It’s probably just a coincidence… But this is creeping me out.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoOp.It’s probably just a coincidence… But this is creeping me out."

translation: To pewnie tylko zbieg okoliczności… Ale to mnie przeraża.

source_text: What exactly did you see in your dream?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What exactly did you see in your dream?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What exactly did you see in your dream?"

translation: Co dokładnie widziałaś w swoim śnie?

source_text: Well… There was a group of women… But they were in a shadow… Very hard to see.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Well… There was a group of women… But they were in a shadow… Very hard to see.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Well… There was a group of women… But they were in a shadow… Very hard to see."

translation: Cóż… Była tam grupa kobiet… Ale były w cieniu… Bardzo trudno dostrzec.

source_text: The room was old… Orange-lit from flames, but too dark to make much out.

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.The room was old… Orange-lit from flames, but too dark to make much out.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.The room was old… Orange-lit from flames, but too dark to make much out."

translation: Pokój był stary… Pomarańczowo oświetlony płomieniami, ale zbyt ciemny, by cokolwiek dostrzec.

source_text: I had a similar dream. I don’t think it’s a coincidence.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I had a similar dream. I don’t think it’s a coincidence.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I had a similar dream. I don’t think it’s a coincidence."

translation: Miałem podobny sen. Nie sądzę, by to był zbieg okoliczności.

source_text: Shit. This is spooky stuff, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiWoCl.Shit. This is spooky stuff, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoCl.Shit. This is spooky stuff, 1Hero."

translation: Cholera. To upiorne sprawy, 1Hero.

source_text: What do you think they are hiding?

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.What do you think they are hiding?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.What do you think they are hiding?"

translation: Jak myślisz, co ukrywają?

source_text: I’ve seen it… There is a room like you describe. Dark, but lit with torches.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’ve seen it… There is a room like you describe. Dark, but lit with torches.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’ve seen it… There is a room like you describe. Dark, but lit with torches."

translation: Widziałem to… Jest pokój taki, jak opisujesz. Ciemny, ale oświetlony pochodniami.

source_text: Yeah…

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Yeah…
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Yeah… "

translation: Tak…

source_text: You can’t go back there. We’re risking getting caught.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.You can’t go back there. We’re risking getting caught.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.You can’t go back there. We’re risking getting caught."

translation: Nie możesz tam wracać. Ryzykujemy, że nas przyłapią.

source_text: We won’t get caught. I just want to see this place for myself.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.We won’t get caught. I just want to see this place for myself.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.We won’t get caught. I just want to see this place for myself."

translation: Nie przyłapią nas. Chcę tylko zobaczyć to miejsce na własne oczy.

source_text: There’s no point.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.There’s no point.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.There’s no point."

translation: Nie ma sensu.

source_text: Of course there is! I’m a reporter. I want to know.

structure.raw_value: KiSaEx.Of course there is! I’m a reporter. I want to know.
structure.script_literal: "KiSaEx.Of course there is! I’m a reporter. I want to know."

translation: Oczywiście, że jest! Jestem reporterką. Chcę wiedzieć.

source_text: Look… You’re going to have a story soon. Just be patient.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Look… You’re going to have a story soon. Just be patient.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Look… You’re going to have a story soon. Just be patient."

translation: Posłuchaj… Wkrótce będziesz mieć historię. Po prostu bądź cierpliwa.

source_text: Does it involve this creepy room?

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.Does it involve this creepy room?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.Does it involve this creepy room?"

translation: Czy ma to związek z tym upiornym pokojem?

source_text: No… The painting… It’s…

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.No… The painting… It’s…
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.No… The painting… It’s…"

translation: Nie… Obraz… To…

source_text: There’s something else going on, and I think you know it.

structure.raw_value: KiAnEx.There’s something else going on, and I think you know it.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnEx.There’s something else going on, and I think you know it."

translation: Dzieje się coś jeszcze i myślę, że o tym wiesz.

source_text: You’re making this difficult, Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You’re making this difficult, Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You’re making this difficult, Kimberly."

translation: Utrudniasz sprawę, Kimberly.

source_text: Come on, 1Hero. We’re in this together…

structure.raw_value: KiFlOp.Come on, 1Hero. We’re in this together…
structure.script_literal: "KiFlOp.Come on, 1Hero. We’re in this together…"

translation: No dalej, 1Hero. Jesteśmy w tym razem…

source_text: We’re very similar, you and I. You know I won't let this go.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.We’re very similar, you and I. You know I won't let this go.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.We’re very similar, you and I. You know I won't let this go."

translation: Jesteśmy bardzo podobni, ty i ja. Wiesz, że tego nie odpuścę.

source_text: We can’t just go in there and start looking around. Lillian or the lepers will see you.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.We can’t just go in there and start looking around. Lillian or the lepers will see you.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.We can’t just go in there and start looking around. Lillian or the lepers will see you."

translation: Nie możemy tam po prostu wejść i rozglądać się. Lillian lub trędowaci cię zobaczą.

source_text: You’re smart. Isn’t there a way to sneak around?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.You’re smart. Isn’t there a way to sneak around?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.You’re smart. Isn’t there a way to sneak around?"

translation: Jesteś sprytny. Nie ma sposobu, by się zakraść?

source_text: Erica… She can help us.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Erica… She can help us.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Erica… She can help us."

translation: Erica… Ona może nam pomóc.

source_text: Lillian’s maid… She’s been helping me spy on her.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Lillian’s maid… She’s been helping me spy on her.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Lillian’s maid… She’s been helping me spy on her."

translation: Pokojówka Lillian… Pomagała mi ją szpiegować.

source_text: Great!... How can she help us?

structure.raw_value: KiFrOp.Great!... How can she help us?
structure.script_literal: "KiFrOp.Great!... How can she help us?"

translation: Świetnie!... Jak może nam pomóc?

source_text: She’s good at distraction… Let me talk to her.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.She’s good at distraction… Let me talk to her.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.She’s good at distraction… Let me talk to her."

translation: Jest dobra w odwracaniu uwagi… Pozwól mi z nią porozmawiać.

source_text: Get her help, 1Hero. There’s something going on under that mansion and I need to know what it is.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Get her help, 1Hero. There’s something going on under that mansion and I need to know what it is.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Get her help, 1Hero. There’s something going on under that mansion and I need to know what it is."

translation: Zdobądź jej pomoc, 1Hero. Pod tą rezydencją dzieje się coś i muszę wiedzieć, co to jest.

source_text: I can’t keep secrets from my producer, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.I can’t keep secrets from my producer, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.I can’t keep secrets from my producer, 1Hero."

translation: Nie mogę trzymać tajemnic przed moim producentem, 1Hero.

source_text: Let’s keep this so-called rift room between us… At least for now.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Let’s keep this so-called rift room between us… At least for now.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Let’s keep this so-called rift room between us… At least for now."

translation: Zachowajmy ten tak zwany pokój szczeliny między nami… Przynajmniej na razie.

source_text: Okay… I’ll trust you.

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.Okay… I’ll trust you.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.Okay… I’ll trust you."

translation: Dobrze… Zaufam ci.

source_text: See ya later, Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.See ya later, Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.See ya later, Kimberly."

translation: Do zobaczenia później, Kimberly.

source_text: See if Lillian’s maid will help us sneak into the mansion.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.See if Lillian’s maid will help us sneak into the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.See if Lillian’s maid will help us sneak into the mansion."

translation: Zobacz, czy pokojówka Lillian pomoże nam zakraść się do rezydencji.

source_text: Nothing’s coming up on the audio. The transmitters have been silent.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Nothing’s coming up on the audio. The transmitters have been silent.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Nothing’s coming up on the audio. The transmitters have been silent."

translation: Nic nie słychać na audio. Nadajniki milczą.

source_text: How long have you been listening?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.How long have you been listening?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.How long have you been listening?"

translation: Jak długo słuchasz?

source_text: I’ve been in this room since I left the mansion. If something happens, I’ll let you know.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.I’ve been in this room since I left the mansion. If something happens, I’ll let you know.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.I’ve been in this room since I left the mansion. If something happens, I’ll let you know."

translation: Byłam w tym pokoju, odkąd wyszłam z rezydencji. Jeśli coś się stanie, dam ci znać.

source_text: There’s something you’re not telling me.

structure.raw_value: KiAnEx.There’s something you’re not telling me.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnEx.There’s something you’re not telling me."

translation: Coś przede mną ukrywasz.

source_text: Just let me hear the audio.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Just let me hear the audio.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Just let me hear the audio."

translation: Po prostu daj mi posłuchać nagrania.

source_text: Listen…

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Listen…
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Listen…"

translation: Posłuchaj…

source_text: I don’t know what the hell they're talking about.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.I don’t know what the hell they're talking about.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.I don’t know what the hell they're talking about."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia, o czym, do cholery, mówią.

source_text: What is the rift, 1Hero? Tell me.

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.What is the rift, 1Hero? Tell me.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.What is the rift, 1Hero? Tell me."

translation: Czym jest szczelina, 1Hero? Powiedz mi.

source_text: Who knows? They are crazy.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Who knows? They are crazy.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Who knows? They are crazy."

translation: Kto wie? Są szaleni.

source_text: Why would I trust you with anything?

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Why would I trust you with anything?
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Why would I trust you with anything?"

translation: Czemu miałbym ci cokolwiek powierzyć?

source_text: We have the same goal. We both want to know what’s happening at that mansion.

structure.raw_value: KiFlEx.We have the same goal. We both want to know what’s happening at that mansion.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlEx.We have the same goal. We both want to know what’s happening at that mansion."

translation: Mamy ten sam cel. Oboje chcemy wiedzieć, co dzieje się w tej rezydencji.

source_text: You just want a story. You’ll step all over the investigation to get it.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You just want a story. You’ll step all over the investigation to get it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You just want a story. You’ll step all over the investigation to get it."

translation: Chcesz tylko historii. Przejedziesz się po śledztwie, by ją zdobyć.

source_text: You’re not part of the investigation anymore.

structure.raw_value: KiAnEx.You’re not part of the investigation anymore.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnEx.You’re not part of the investigation anymore."

translation: Nie jesteś już częścią śledztwa.

source_text: Thanks to you!

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Thanks to you!
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Thanks to you!"

translation: Dzięki tobie!

source_text: 1Hero… I’ve been having dreams ever since we went into that secret basement.

structure.raw_value: KiWoEx.1Hero… I’ve been having dreams ever since we went into that secret basement.
structure.script_literal: "KiWoEx.1Hero… I’ve been having dreams ever since we went into that secret basement."

translation: 1Hero… Mam sny, odkąd weszliśmy do tej tajnej piwnicy.

source_text: I know you’re hiding something.

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.I know you’re hiding something.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.I know you’re hiding something."

translation: Wiem, że coś ukrywasz.

source_text: You have no idea what you’re talking about. You’re just having nightmares.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You have no idea what you’re talking about. You’re just having nightmares.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You have no idea what you’re talking about. You’re just having nightmares."

translation: Nie masz pojęcia, o czym mówisz. Masz tylko koszmary.

source_text: I’m going to find out, one way or another.

structure.raw_value: KiAnOp.I’m going to find out, one way or another.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnOp.I’m going to find out, one way or another."

translation: Dowiem się, tak czy inaczej.

source_text: You promised not to visit the mansion again.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You promised not to visit the mansion again.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You promised not to visit the mansion again."

translation: Obiecałaś, że nie odwiedzisz już rezydencji.

source_text: You’re not a detective anymore. I’ll do what I have to do.

structure.raw_value: KiAnEx.You’re not a detective anymore. I’ll do what I have to do.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnEx.You’re not a detective anymore. I’ll do what I have to do."

translation: Nie jesteś już detektywem. Zrobię, co muszę.

source_text: Stay away from the mansion, Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Stay away from the mansion, Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Stay away from the mansion, Kimberly."

translation: Trzymaj się z daleka od rezydencji, Kimberly.

source_text: You can’t hide this from me, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiAnOp.You can’t hide this from me, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiAnOp.You can’t hide this from me, 1Hero."

translation: Nie ukryjesz tego przede mną, 1Hero.

source_text: You don’t know what you’re getting into.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.You don’t know what you’re getting into.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.You don’t know what you’re getting into."

translation: Nie wiesz, w co się pakujesz.

source_text: And that’s supposed to make me back down?

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.And that’s supposed to make me back down?
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.And that’s supposed to make me back down?"

translation: I to ma sprawić, że się wycofam?

source_text: If you go there, you’ll get caught. I’m not helping you this time.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.If you go there, you’ll get caught. I’m not helping you this time.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.If you go there, you’ll get caught. I’m not helping you this time."

translation: Jeśli tam pójdziesz, przyłapią cię. Tym razem ci nie pomogę.

source_text: I’ll see ya around.

structure.raw_value: KiFlDe.I’ll see ya around.
structure.script_literal: "KiFlDe.I’ll see ya around."

translation: Do zobaczenia.

source_text: I want to see what’s in that mansion’s basement.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.I want to see what’s in that mansion’s basement.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.I want to see what’s in that mansion’s basement."

translation: Chcę zobaczyć, co jest w piwnicy tej rezydencji.
